settings.previewText: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Writing is an exploration. You start from nothing and learn as you go.
settings.languageDesc: The language of the app's own interface. Your Pages are untouched.
settings.workspaceDesc: A folder on your disk. doXmind reads and writes Markdown into the place you point it at — files never move.
settings.workspaceExcludesDesc: Folder names doXmind skips when scanning this workspace, one per line. .git, node_modules, dist, build, out, target, .next and .doxmind are always skipped.
settings.aboutPrivacyBody1: doXmind is local-first desktop software. Your documents stay in the folders you choose on this Mac.
settings.aboutPrivacyBody2: This edition has no sign-in, cloud sync, telemetry, billing, sharing, community publishing, or built-in AI feature or runtime.
settings.aboutPrivacyBody3: Network access is limited to actions you explicitly start, such as opening external links or using operating-system services.
settings.aboutAcknowledgementsBody1: doXmind is proprietary software built with Electron, React, Next.js, and other open-source components. Python is used only by optional browser-development and repository tooling, not the packaged app.
settings.aboutAcknowledgementsBody2: We thank the maintainers of the open-source libraries used inside the app. Their work makes a local-first Markdown editor practical to ship.
settings.aboutAcknowledgementsBody3: doXmind itself is not open source; these acknowledgements are for the third-party components included with the product.
